## [1.27.0](https://github.com/dhrubonai/morphe-patches/releases/tag/v1.27.0) (2026-10-11)

### Bug Fixes

* **MovieBox - All-In-One:** fixed crash on launch when patching MovieBox 4.0.03.0918.03. Updated extension files (AppPatch, DashFile, DashServer) to handle the new Edge-Cache cookie format, CloudFront play-info failover, resource-position API, and parallel CDN reads. Telegram popup and coffee button preserved.
